name: Corgi
description: Runs your coding agents in a terminal multiplexer that shows which are working, finished or need you, with a scriptable CLI. For developers juggling Claude Code, Codex, Pi and OpenCode.

skills.name: Agent status
skills.description: Shows whether each agent is working, needs you, or is done, with activity summaries.

skills.name: Context and rate limits
skills.description: Tracks each agent's context, tokens and rate limits.

skills.name: Resume sessions
skills.description: Resumes agent sessions after a crash or reboot, and lets you detach and reconnect.

skills.name: Scripting
skills.description: Controls the running session from any shell: list panes, open tabs, send input and read output, with JSON output.
